Vendored browser libraries for static hosting:
- Supabase JS 2.117.3 (MIT), downloaded from its npm UMD distribution.
- PDF.js 6.4.299 (Apache-2.0), npm build/pdf.mjs and pdf.worker.mjs.
- Mammoth 1.13.0 (BSD-2-Clause), browser distribution.
Libraries run locally; no CDN requests are needed at runtime.
